steps.en: Install the CLI, load the extension, and install its skill into your harness
steps.zh: 装好 CLI、加载扩展，再把 skill 装进你的 harness

steps.en: Start a session and keep the session id the agent gets back
steps.zh: 开一个 session，agent 拿到 session_id

steps.en: The daemon routes each command to your extension, which runs it in a separate Agent Window
steps.zh: daemon 把命令转给扩展，在独立 Agent Window 里跑

steps.en: Observe the page for fresh @eN refs, then click or fill by ref
steps.zh: 先 observe 拿到 @eN 引用，再用引用点击、填表

steps.en: To touch a tab you already have open, it asks you first, borrows it, and leaves your windows alone
steps.zh: 要动你已经开着的页签时，先向你确认再借走，你原来的窗口不受影响

steps.en: On login or CAPTCHA it hands control back to you, then resumes where it stopped
steps.zh: 遇到登录或验证码，就把控制权交还给你，你处理完它接着跑

steps.en: When the task ends it returns the borrowed tab and stops the session
steps.zh: 任务结束时归还借走的页签，并关闭 session

value.en: Your real, logged-in browser does the work while you keep using it — no separate test account, no login replay
value.zh: 用你真正登录着的浏览器干活，且不耽误你自己用它；不用另建测试账号，也不必重放登录
